extracted.intended_audience: PubMed users, researchers, students, and librarians trying to determine whether a journal is peer-reviewed
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for determining whether journals indexed in PubMed are peer-reviewed and where to find lists or resources that identify refereed/peer-reviewed journals. Includes limitations of PubMed and alternative resources to consult.

rubrics_metrics.name: NLM does not maintain a list of peer-reviewed/refereed journals
rubrics_metrics.description: NLM has no list of peer-reviewed or refereed journals. You cannot limit a PubMed® search to peer-reviewed or refereed journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implication: do not expect a built-in PubMed filter or an NLM-maintained authoritative list; users must verify peer-review status by other means or external resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Most PubMed-indexed journals are peer-reviewed but criteria vary
rubrics_metrics.description: Most journals indexed for PubMed are peer-reviewed or refereed, but peer review criteria and reviewer or referee qualifications vary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implication: 'peer-reviewed' status is common but inconsistent in quality and process across journals; treat the label as variable and verify important details on a per-journal basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check a journal's editorial information or ask the publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: Check a journal's editorial information or ask the publisher about policy for specific journal titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical steps: look at a journal’s editorial policies or 'About' page, instructions for authors, editorial board listings, or contact the publisher directly to confirm whether review is external/blinded/what reviewers' qualifications are.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use CINAHL's 'Peer Reviewed' subset
rubrics_metrics.description: Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature (CINAHL) database, published by EBSCO, has a Peer Reviewed subset.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access note: CINAHL is typically available through local libraries; use its 'Peer Reviewed' subset to limit results to titles CINAHL marks as peer reviewed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult Medical and Health Care Books and Serials in Print (Serials volume)
rubrics_metrics.description: Medical and Health Care Books and Serials in Print, edited by Bowker staff and published by Grey House Publishing; the Serials volume has a symbol in front of refereed journal titles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access note: this reference work (often available in libraries) marks refereed journal titles with a symbol—use it to identify journals labeled as refereed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Ulrichsweb (Global Serials Directory) to find 'refereed' status
rubrics_metrics.description: Ulrichsweb: a Global Serials Directory published by ProQuest LLC, provides information on each journal record if it is a refereed journal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access note: Ulrichsweb is subscription-based (often via libraries); search a journal record to see whether Ulrichsweb lists it as 'refereed'.
